Hello! Let's create your voice for AlarmTalk together.
Every morning, this voice will wake someone you love. Doesn't that sound exciting?

The sky is clear and the breeze is soft today. A perfect day for a walk, isn't it?
On days like this, don't you feel like wandering around with a warm cup of coffee?

Now, shall we read some numbers together?
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

On happy days, laugh as much as you want. On tiring days, tell yourself, "You did well today."
And in the morning, open the window and take a deep breath. The day feels so much lighter.

This is the last part already. Thank you for reading clearly all the way.

A registered voice is used to create a voice profile, read alarm lines aloud, play alarms, and cache audio on this device. Voice cloning and text-to-speech run through our voice AI provider ElevenLabs, and your voice and text are sent overseas as part of that. AlarmTalk does not use your voice for public search, advertising, or data sales, and does not train its own general-purpose AI models on it. You can delete a voice profile at any time.
I consent to my voice (biometric information) being used to create a voice profile, clone the voice, and generate speech.
I consent to my voice and text being transferred and processed overseas (including the United States) for voice AI processing.

News about new features, events, and offers, sent by push or email. Declining changes nothing about signing up or using the app, and you can turn it off any time from the More tab. Promotional messages are only sent between 8am and 9pm; alarms you set yourself are not promotions and ring exactly when you scheduled them.
Only the items that changed are listed below. Everything you already agreed to stays as it is.

When an alarm line is turned into speech, the text and voice are processed by our voice AI provider (ElevenLabs) and by text generation (Google, United States). That means the data is sent overseas. You can keep using alarms without agreeing, but you will not be able to create spoken alarms.
